message.content: On March 7th, WolfgangSchulz and LiHua plan to attend a concert together. From the conversation in Source 1, it is clearly stated that WolfgangSchulz mentions, "Hey! Got an extra ticket for a concert on March 7th at 6 PM." Therefore, the name of the concert that Wolfgang and Li Hua will attend on March 7th is a concert taking place on March 7th at 6 PM.
